projects.title: Online Cinema Platform — FastAPI, Async Architecture, RBAC, Celery, WebSockets
projects.summary: A production-grade backend for an online cinema platform built with FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery. The system implements a complete authentication and authorization flow, real-time features, background task processing, and a modular domain-driven architecture suitable for scaling into a full streaming service.
highlights: Fully asynchronous backend built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy 2.0, Redis, and Celery
Advanced authentication system with JWT, refresh tokens, account activation, and secure password handling
Role-based access control (RBAC) with User / Moderator / Admin permissions and protected routes.
Background task pipeline using Celery for email notifications and account lifecycle events
Real-time features powered by WebSockets (live comments, notifications, chat)
Clean domain-driven architecture with repositories, services, and strict Pydantic validation
Movie catalog with ratings, likes, favorites, comments, and user profile management
Comprehensive integration test suite using pytest-asyncio and isolated PostgreSQL test databases

projects.title: Theatre API Service
projects.summary: An API service for theatre management built with Django REST Framework, supporting shows, performances, bookings, and user roles.
highlights: Built a fully authenticated REST API using JWT tokens, custom email-based login, and role-based access control
Designed a relational data model with complex FK/M2M relationships, validation rules, and database-level constraints to ensure data integrity (e.g., unique seat reservations per performance)
Implemented advanced business logic including automatic seat availability calculation, multi-layer ticket validation, and user-bound reservation creation
Developed a scalable API layer with DRF ViewSets, nested serializers, and optimized queries using select_related / prefetch_related to eliminate N+1 issues
Containerized the entire environment with Docker + Postgres + PgAdmin
Added JWT token blacklisting with automated cleanup via Celery, Celery Beat, Redis

Designed a dynamic assignment system allowing cooks to be added/removed from dishes via a toggle action.
Added search, filtering, and pagination across all major list views for efficient data navigation.
Enhanced UX with custom middleware, optimized queries using prefetch_related, and persistent query parameters
